# endpoints read: Darts/15, Baseball/12, Tennis/3, Ice_Hockey/13, Ice_Hockey/NHL/13, Cricket/7,
#   Rugby_Union/9, Basketball/4, Golf/5, Motor_Racing/14, Volleyball/21, Handball/20, Snooker/8,

#   Cycling, Swimming, Diving, Chess, Lacrosse, Rowing and Badminton rows that appear on the OLBG
# GOLF: https://www.olbg.com/betting-tips/Golf/5 rendered "No tips found." at 2026-10-23T16:22Z — an
#   empty listing, not a retrieval failure. No Golf row is invented; see flag FL-131. Yesterday's Golf
#   rows re-enter the board through the previous_harvest chain and are marked "carried".
# SNOOKER / GREYHOUNDS: both rendered "No tips found." on the 2026-10-22 evening pass (FL-123) and are
#   BOTH LIVE AGAIN in this capture (Snooker 2 rows, Greyhounds 16 rows) — FL-123 is resolved.
# RUGBY LEAGUE: the listing renders three outright markets only (State of Origin 2027, Super League
#   2027, NRL 2027) and no club fixture, so no Rugby League match row exists to publish.
# TRUNCATION CAVEAT: OLBG server-renders only the first tips and hides the rest behind a client-side
#   "Load More Tips" control that no non-JS retrieval can expand (FL-124). Where a retrieved chunk
#   ended mid-row, the partial row is recorded with blank tips and its note says so; nothing is
#   inferred. One Volleyball row (VfB Friedrichshafen vs SSC Karlsruhe) was cut before its event id
#   rendered, so it is NOT published here — see flag FL-132.
# CLOCK CAVEAT: OLBG prints bare clocks with no timezone label; the render basis has been observed to
#   differ between endpoints and to shift within a day (see harvest_timezone_note in data/meta.json),
#   so no clock here is converted. This capture adds two endpoint-specific corroborations of a US
#   Eastern basis: the 5:12 Towcester greyhound race (official UK post time 17:12 BST = 16:12 UTC)
#   rendered as "Today 12:12" and already carried an "Expired" control at the 16:2xZ capture; and the
#   two NHL rows rendered 20:07 / 21:07 against official NHL API startTimeUTC of 2026-10-24T00:00:00Z
#   and 2026-10-24T01:00:00Z (20:00 / 21:00 EDT). Per FL-121 only the timezone-qualified official
